tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i gsal byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa cung zad bkrol na/ nyal ldang 'dra/ khrus byed na mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ ngag 'don rnams yab kyi mngon rtogs/ yan lag drug pa'i mdzes rgyan dang phal cher 'dra ba la/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par tho yig ltar byed/ de la bdag dang 'gro ba sogs nas/ gsol gyi 'dra/ sems can thams cad sogs nas/ de'i ched du rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /gsum pa rang gi spyi bor sogs nas 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i snying gar raṃ sogs nas/ maṇḍal bhyaḥyi bar tho yig bzhin/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs dang / dkon mchog gsum la sogs gsum/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs gsum/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs/ oṃ shu n+yā ta sogs nas/ me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ rakṣa sogs gsum/ 'dir khro bcu'i srung 'khor mi snang ngo / /de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas su sogs nas/ bhrūṃ gyis mtshan pa de dag gi nam mkha' oṃ āḥsogs nas gzhal yas khang 'phar ma gnyis dang bcas pa gru bzhi pa sogs nas/ rgyan du mas brgyan pa'i gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni shar du gtum drag sogs mngon rtogs mdzes bzhin/ bsdu na/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad sogs/ rgyas bsdus gang ltar yang / yongs su bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang 'phar ma gnyis pa'i nang gi lha rnams shar nas/ dbus sngo ba'i dbus su sna tshogs padma sogs nas/ a nu ra ga'i bar tho yig bzhin/

lus dkyil bsgom na de'i mjug tu a nu rā ga brjod pa'ang snang / pho brang lnga dang sogs yab kyi lus dkyil yod med gnyis 'dug kyang yod pa legs snyam/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i dbang gi lha sogs nas dzaḥ dkar mo sogs/ zhe sdang rdo rje sogs/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs/ byang chub rdo rje sogs nas/ rig pa'i dbang lnga/ brtul zhugs/ dam tshig gsum bum dbang / dbang gong ma gsum/ sher dbang rang he ru kar 'pho ba rnams lus dkyil mdzes rgyan bzhin/ cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ mdun gyi dbang lha rnams 'od du zhu/ phyi nang gi lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas thim pas dbang gi chu rgyun des sogs nas/ a bhi ṣe ka ta'i bar tho yig bzhin/ bdud rtsi myang ba/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta nas ha ho hrīḥyi bar dang / oṃ sarba sogs nas haṃ/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs haṃ/ 'gro ba bud med bskyed rim la sems bzung sogs kha dog bsam pa zhen spang / de nas rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang phru ma phus btab pa lta bu dmar sang nges pa'i dbus rtsa gsum 'khor lo bzhi'i rdzogs rim bsgom/ dag pa dran pa bya/ rdzogs rim gong ltar byas kyang yong / bzlas pa'i tshe sngags phreng zhal nas lte ba'am/ lte ba nas zhal du zhugs pa'i lugs kyang snang ngo / /zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sngags kyi kha dog bsgyur tshul 'dra/ 'khor rnams la rang rang gi sa bon de nyid lngas spel ba/ oṃ āḥ.aṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ces rdo rje ma dang / oṃ āḥ.iṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gsang ba'i dkar mo dang / oṃ āḥ.īṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma dang / oṃ āḥ.uṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang / oṃ āḥ.ūṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ /pukka se dang / oṃ āḥṛṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sha wa rwi dang / oṃ āḥṝṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gdol pa mo dang / oṃ āḥl̥ṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/

g.yung mo dang / oṃ āḥlīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ gau rī dang / oṃ āḥ.eṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ tsau ri dang / oṃ āḥ.aiṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ betta li dang / oṃ āḥ.oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ghasma rī dang / oṃ āḥbhū tsa rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sa spyod ma dang / oṃ āḥkhe tsa rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ mkha' spyod ma'o/ /bsdus pa byed na oṃ āḥ.a ā sogs phreng sngags so/ /gsol btab/ bde bar gshegs pa sogs nas/ mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i go 'phang sogs brjod cing phreng ba rang gi spyi bor bzhag dkyil 'khor bsdu ba 'dra/ nyal ldang 'dra/ thor thun ma yin pa'i gtor ma dang 'brel na de'i rjes dang / de ma yin pa'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba grub rjes/ kolla sogs rdo glu phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi bkra shis/ rigs su skye dang sogs smon lam/ spyod lam gyi tshe rang rdo rje bdag med mar gsal ba'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje sogs/ 'gro ba thams cad bdag med ma'i ngo bor rnam par dag pa yin no/ /dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas sogs/ rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /kha zas kyi rnal 'byor thugs kha'i aṃ ma gtogs 'dra/ gtor ma dang mchod pa'i rnal 'byor rgyas pa yab dang 'dra/ bsdus pa la bsangs sbyang / oṃ kyis sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas gsang ba'i thod pa/ āḥyis rdzas rnams zhu/ hūm̐ phun sum tshogs par bsam/ skad cig tsam gyis 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mgron ma lus pa spyan drangs nas/ phyogs bcu gang bar bzhugs par gyur/ thugs kha'i aṃ las 'od 'phros te de rnams la phogs pas thams cad kyang bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bcu thams cad gang bar gyur/ dmigs pa bcas/ a kā ro gsum/ bdun nyer gcig gang rung / mgron rnams mi dmigs par bzhag rdo glu bkra shis smon lam sogs 'dra/ bdag bskyed rkyang pa nyams su len tshul lo/

/dbang 'bring po len tshul yang go bar bya'o/ /dkyil chog dgos mchod rgyas par bsham na/ spos mar me gsum tshan bzhi shar du/ nub tu gsum/ lho byang gnyis su gnyis/ mtshams bzhi re re te bco lnga'o/ /de yang shar gyi rnams nub kyi 'og gi yong ngo / /nub kyi rnams shar gyi steng la/ lho byang gis/ byang lho'i ngo mtshams 'dra/ sngon 'gro sogs la ras bris la bzhengs te zhes te zhes pa'i tshig dor gang dag nag po sogs dang / yum gyi phreng sngags/ gnas yo byin rlabs/ zhu 'bul 'dra/ mngon rtogs song nas he ru kar gyur/ phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par/ hi hi zhes brjod pas bgegs rnams bskrad par gyur/ sa lha'i tshom bu bsangs sbyangs sogs cho ga gzhan 'dra/ bdag med ma dpal khros mchod pas/ /zhes bsgyur/ lha sta gon tshem bu bsangs sbyangs/ thun mong ba'i srung 'khor/ 'byung bzhi 'khor lo dang bcas pa las gzhal yas khang dur khrod ro'i gdan re re zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra/ oṃ badzra nai ratma tho bzhin/ skye mched byin rlabs lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs/ ye shes pa dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ 'gro ba bud med kyis bstod/ gau rī a garṣa ya sogs/ dbang lha/ dkar mo sogs/ zhe sdang sogs/ bcom ldan de bzhin sogs/ mchod pa dri med yid 'od sogs/ gos zung nang mchod gtor ma/ lha thams cad kyi phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba re re byung ba bsam/ bstod pa spro na/ rje sa chen dang 'phags pas mdzad pa yang bya/ bum pa 'phar ma med/ lha mo bco lnga bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ 'das gtor gyi bskyed chog dur khrod brgyad du sogs 'dra/ mtshan sngags/ oṃ bha ga wa ti ma hā ka ru ṇi ka nai ratma ya sa pa ri wa ra oṃ ni rī sogs/ gtor ma oṃ bha ga wa ti sogs nas sa pa ri wā ra oṃ inda sogs/ puṣpe sogs/ oṃ aṃ āṃ sogs la 'bru gsum btags pa'i nang mchod/

lha mo bco lnga sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang bcas pa'i zhal du sogs/ dkar mo ri dwags/ sogs 'gro ba bud med sogs/ mi bskyod rdo rje sogs nas shog sgos kyi chos skyong / mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs 'dra/ slob ma sta gon dgos na cung zad ma gtogs 'dra/ rjes chog kyang cung zad ma gtogs 'dra'o/ /dngos gzhi la mal cher thor gsal/ ras bris la'ang bum pa phul na legs/ ma byung kyang chad pa'i skyon med/ mdun bskyed sgrub tshe rang nyid he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs kha'i sa bon aṃ ngo / /mdun bskyed brtan byed/ aṃ badzra nai ratma/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sogs/ gtso bor brgya rtsa 'khor la nyer gcig sogs nas tshar re'ang rung / brtan bzhugs byas nas he ru ka'i rnam pas bye/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas bstod pa'i bar sta gon dang 'dra/ bdud rtsi myong ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas/ snying ga'i aṃ lha mo thams cad kyi ngo bo mnyes par bsam pa 'di ma chad pa gal che/ sgrub grogs gnyis phreng sngags bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung / phyi rol gzhan 'dra zhing khyad par cung zad ni sngon 'gro'i gtor mar shes so/ /gtor ma phyir dor tshe phreng sngags dang rol mo/ nang du bdag las dang po pa'i sogs sam/ ma 'byor pa gang rung / bdag 'jug dbang rdzas rnams gtso bo'i thugs kha nas bye ba'i he ru ka gcig gis ster bar bsam/ gsol 'debs bdag med ma'i mgrin 'khyud sogs 'dra/ sdom bsgrags bdag 'jug la mi mdzad/ ye shes dbab pa'i maṇḍal/ gsol gdab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol gsum/ rang nyid rdo rje bdag med ma'i rang bzhin he ru kar gsal ba'i sogs kyis dbab brtan/ gsol gdab/ kha dog zhe sdang rdo rje sogs/ me tog phul mig ras bcings bkrol sogs nas/ hoḥhoḥhoḥ'i bar/ maṇḍal/

byang chub rdo rje gsum/ dbang stegs 'dra/ bdag med mar bskyed/ de'i steng du bla bre sogs/ sbyang ba rnams 'dra/ bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba sogs/ bdag 'jug la mig thur byin rlabs mi dgos/ mjug tu oṃ nam mkha' skye ba sogs shes rab thabs dag kyang sgra ji bzhin pa dgos so/ /rjes chog sogs nang mchod phreng sngags oṃ aṃ āṃ sogs 'bru gsum/ lha mo bco lnga'i zhal du sogs/ rdul tshon skabs mtshams kyi pad 'dab kyi bum pa sngon po thod pas mtshan pa/ gzhan tho'i gsal/ gzhan la dbang bskur la/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ brtag gnyis las lha mo bco lnga'i chos skor ji ltar bstan tshul sogs rnam gzhag zhib par bla ma gong ma'i gsung bzhin dang / nang dbang gi tshe slob dpon rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma'i rang bzhin rnam pa he ru ka zhal gcig gnyis pa yab yum gyi sku can sogs/ slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i aṃ las 'od zer sogs slob ma yum gyi padmar bdag med ma'i sku can du gyur sogs/ khyad don zhu bar maṇḍal dang / bdag med ma'i mgrin 'khyud sogs lus kyi bya ba'i skabs su maṇḍal mi mdzad/ rgyun bshags kyi yul lha mo bco lnga'i dkyil 'khor la sangs rgyas sogs/ bsrung ba'i tshe slob dpon gyi thugs kha'i aṃ las 'od zer bskal pa'i me sogs yum gyi phreng sngags gsum byin rlabs/ khyed rang rnams bdag med ma'i rang bzhin he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par sogs/ dri chu lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i mthe bos mthe'u chung mnan/ gung mdzub srin lag gsum brkyang ba'i rtses/ g.yon gyi ting la sogs pa'i dri bzang gi chu blangs/ rdo rje ma gsum rgyan cha lugs yongs rdzogs gsal btab grub rjes/ khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje ma gsum las yig 'bru gsum dang / 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum dpag tu med pa 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs khar phog pas thugs kha nas sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin yi ge 'bru gsum dang /

'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam pa can dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum gyi rdo rje gsum la thim pas tha mal gyi lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs te/ lus ngag yid gsum de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sogs/ so shing las bum gyi chu dang / a mṛ tas bsangs sogs/ phreng sngags dang / oṃ dzi ho sogs/ khyor chu phreng sngags dang / hrīḥbi shuddha sogs kyi sngags nas byin/ bsrung skud/ a mṛ tas bsangs pa sogs 'dra/ phreng sngags bzlas/ kha blangs phog pa bya/ ku sha'ang bsangs sbyangs/ phreng sngags tshar gnyis/ dhīḥha gsum/ gzhan rnams 'dra'o/ /dngos gzhi la sems bskyed gsal btab/ bshad pa skabs su gang bab rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar/ ye shes dbab pa'i spogs chog slar yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyi mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma'i steng du āḥlas padma āḥyis mtshan pa/ snying gar nyi ma'i steng du aṃ las gri gug aṃ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi phyag mtshan dang rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i rnam pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du thim pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus pa ma lus pa zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ phreng sngags dang rol mo/ chu bzhi'i sbyangs bar zhabs bsil gyis zhabs bkrus par mos pa mdzod/ oṃ ni rī sogs/ phyag rgya'i mthar se gol tog des 'gre/ tshar rim gyi snod kha phub/ rig dbang skabs/ ye shes pa/ slob ma la gau rī sogs kyis bstims/ dbang rdzas la dzaḥhūm̐ sogs/ ming dbang gi tshe rdo dril lhan cig dkrol zhing dri/ dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa bsdu na/ dkyil 'khor zhes bshad ma mi brjod pa snang / mig thur aṣṭas byin gyis rlobs pa yang snang / me long rdo rje bcas nam nai ratma/

bdag med ma dpal me long ltar/ gsal zhing sogs bdag med ma'i rang bzhin gtso/ 'di bdag 'jug la'ang nges dogs par snang / dbang bzhi bskur ba'i slob dpon la rim bzhin sbyar/ gsang mtshan tshe yod pa rnams slob ma rang gis brjod pa ltar slob dpon gyis kyang brjod/ med pa'am brjod pa 'dogs dgos/ gzhan 'dra/ de ltar rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma lha mo bco lnga'i sgrub dkyil dbang gi tho yig 'di rje btsun dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i kyai rdor mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan/ dbang chu mdzes rgyan/ gtor chog mdzes rgyan/ dbang bshad rgyas bsdus rnams gzhir bzhag mi 'dra ba'i khyad par tho yig gi mdzad pa'i gsal byed 'di dpal sa skya pa sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ma nor gsal byed/ dkyil chog 'phrin las kun khyab/ dbang gi mtshams sbyor 'phrin las rab rgyas rnams la brten nas dpe yongs rdzogs 'bri ma nus pas brjed byang cung zad sangs rgyas phun tshogs kyis bkod pa'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bdag med ma'i sgrub dkyil gyi tho yig PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 7
